```{r}
# ============================================================
# CROSS-SPECIES GPS REGULARIZATION
# WHITE-TAILED DEER + MULE DEER
#
# FINAL REGULARIZATION POLICY
#
# White-tailed deer:
#   target hours = 00:00, 09:00, 18:00
#
# Mule deer:
#   target hours = 00:00, 08:00, 16:00
#
# Daily inclusion:
#   retain animal-days with >= 2 of 3 target fixes
#
# Trajectory continuity:
#   start a new segment if gap > 16 hours
#
# Training = CWD-
# Testing  = CWD+
#
# IMPORTANT:
#   Movement metrics should be recalculated AFTER this script,
#   using id + segment_id as grouping variables.
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# 1. PACKAGES
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)


# ============================================================
# 2. COLUMN SETTINGS
# ============================================================

ID_COL <- "id"

DATETIME_COL <- "date_time"

SEASON_COL <- "season"


# ============================================================
# 3. SPECIES-SPECIFIC TARGET HOURS
# ============================================================

# White-tailed deer originally follow approximately
# a 3-hour schedule.
#
# Select three actual scheduled observations/day.

WTD_TARGET_HOURS <- c(
  0,
  9,
  18
)


# Mule deer predominantly follow approximately
# an 8-hour schedule.

MULE_TARGET_HOURS <- c(
  0,
  8,
  16
)


# ============================================================
# 4. REGULARIZATION SETTINGS
# ============================================================

# Maximum difference between target time and actual fix
# allowed for assignment.

MAX_TIME_DIFFERENCE_MIN <- 120


# Minimum number of retained target fixes required
# for an animal-day.

MIN_FIXES_PER_DAY <- 2


# A new trajectory segment begins if the gap between
# consecutive retained observations exceeds this value.

MAX_CONTINUOUS_GAP_HOURS <- 16


# ============================================================
# 5. FILE PATHS
# ============================================================

WTD_TRAIN_FILE <-
  "<LOCAL_PATH>"

WTD_TEST_FILE <-
  "<LOCAL_PATH>"

MULE_TRAIN_FILE <-
  "<LOCAL_PATH>"

MULE_TEST_FILE <-
  "<LOCAL_PATH>"


# ============================================================
# 6. OUTPUT FOLDER
# ============================================================

OUTPUT_DIR <-
  "<LOCAL_PATH>"


dir.create(
  OUTPUT_DIR,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


# ============================================================
# 7. LOAD DATA
# ============================================================

wtd_train_raw <- read_csv(
  WTD_TRAIN_FILE,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

wtd_test_raw <- read_csv(
  WTD_TEST_FILE,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

mule_train_raw <- read_csv(
  MULE_TRAIN_FILE,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

mule_test_raw <- read_csv(
  MULE_TEST_FILE,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


# ============================================================
# 8. CHECK REQUIRED COLUMNS
# ============================================================

check_required_columns <- function(
    data,
    dataset_name
) {

  required <- c(
    ID_COL,
    DATETIME_COL
  )

  missing_cols <- setdiff(
    required,
    names(data)
  )

  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {

    stop(
      paste0(
        dataset_name,
        " is missing required columns: ",
        paste(
          missing_cols,
          collapse = ", "
        )
      )
    )
  }
}


check_required_columns(
  wtd_train_raw,
  "WTD CWD- training"
)

check_required_columns(
  wtd_test_raw,
  "WTD CWD+ testing"
)

check_required_columns(
  mule_train_raw,
  "Mule deer CWD- training"
)

check_required_columns(
  mule_test_raw,
  "Mule deer CWD+ testing"
)


# ============================================================
# 9. ROBUST DATETIME PARSER
#
# Does NOT use parse_date_time().
# ============================================================

parse_gps_datetime <- function(x) {

  x <- as.character(x)

  x <- trimws(x)


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Replace ISO "T"
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  x <- gsub(
    "T",
    " ",
    x,
    fixed = TRUE
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Remove trailing Z
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  x <- gsub(
    "Z$",
    "",
    x
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Remove fractional seconds
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  x <- sub(
    "\\.[0-9]+$",
    "",
    x
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Initialize POSIXct output
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  out <- as.POSIXct(
    rep(
      NA_character_,
      length(x)
    ),
    tz = "UTC"
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  bad <- is.na(out) & !is.na(x)

  if (any(bad)) {

    out[bad] <- suppressWarnings(
      as.POSIXct(
        x[bad],
        format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
        tz = "UTC"
      )
    )
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  bad <- is.na(out) & !is.na(x)

  if (any(bad)) {

    out[bad] <- suppressWarnings(
      as.POSIXct(
        x[bad],
        format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M",
        tz = "UTC"
      )
    )
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  bad <- is.na(out) & !is.na(x)

  if (any(bad)) {

    out[bad] <- suppressWarnings(
      as.POSIXct(
        x[bad],
        format = "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S",
        tz = "UTC"
      )
    )
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  bad <- is.na(out) & !is.na(x)

  if (any(bad)) {

    out[bad] <- suppressWarnings(
      as.POSIXct(
        x[bad],
        format = "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M",
        tz = "UTC"
      )
    )
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM:SS
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  bad <- is.na(out) & !is.na(x)

  if (any(bad)) {

    out[bad] <- suppressWarnings(
      as.POSIXct(
        x[bad],
        format = "%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S",
        tz = "UTC"
      )
    )
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  bad <- is.na(out) & !is.na(x)

  if (any(bad)) {

    out[bad] <- suppressWarnings(
      as.POSIXct(
        x[bad],
        format = "%Y/%m/%d %H:%M",
        tz = "UTC"
      )
    )
  }


  return(out)
}


# ============================================================
# 10. PREPARE GPS DATA
# ============================================================

prepare_gps <- function(
    data,
    species_name,
    cwd_status,
    dataset_type
) {

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Standardize ID and datetime source fields
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  data[[ID_COL]] <-
    as.character(
      data[[ID_COL]]
    )


  data[[DATETIME_COL]] <-
    as.character(
      data[[DATETIME_COL]]
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Parse standardized datetime
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  data$.datetime <-
    parse_gps_datetime(
      data[[DATETIME_COL]]
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Parsing diagnostics
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  n_total <-
    nrow(data)

  n_failed <-
    sum(
      is.na(data$.datetime)
    )

  n_success <-
    n_total -
    n_failed


  cat(
    "\n\n====================================\n",
    species_name,
    " ",
    cwd_status,
    "\n",
    "====================================\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  cat(
    "Successfully parsed: ",
    n_success,
    " / ",
    n_total,
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  cat(
    "Failed to parse: ",
    n_failed,
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  if (n_success == 0) {

    cat(
      "\nFirst 10 datetime value<LOCAL_PATH>"
    )

    print(
      head(
        data[[DATETIME_COL]],
        10
      )
    )

    stop(
      paste0(
        "No timestamps could be parsed for ",
        species_name,
        " ",
        cwd_status
      )
    )
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Drop unparseable timestamps
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  data <- data %>%

    filter(
      !is.na(.datetime)
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Create standardized date and labels
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  data <- data %>%

    mutate(

      .date =
        as.Date(
          .datetime,
          tz = "UTC"
        ),

      species =
        species_name,

      cwd_group =
        cwd_status,

      dataset =
        dataset_type

    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Remove conflicting original date field
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  data <- data %>%

    select(
      -any_of("date")
    )


  return(data)
}


# ============================================================
# 11. PREPARE ALL FOUR DATASETS
# ============================================================

wtd_train_raw <- prepare_gps(

  data =
    wtd_train_raw,

  species_name =
    "White-tailed deer",

# ============================================================
# 12. REGULARIZATION FUNCTION
# ============================================================

regularize_gps <- function(
    data,
    target_hours,
    max_difference_min =
      MAX_TIME_DIFFERENCE_MIN
) {

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Grouping variables
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  grouping_vars <- c(
    ID_COL,
    ".date"
  )


  if (
    !is.null(SEASON_COL) &&
    SEASON_COL %in% names(data)
  ) {

    grouping_vars <- c(
      ID_COL,
      SEASON_COL,
      ".date"
    )

  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Unique animal-days
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  animal_days <- data %>%

    distinct(

      across(
        all_of(
          grouping_vars
        )
      )

    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Generate target times
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  target_times <- animal_days %>%

    tidyr::crossing(

      target_hour =
        target_hours

    ) %>%

    mutate(

      target_datetime =

        as.POSIXct(
          .date,
          tz = "UTC"
        ) +

        hours(
          target_hour
        )

    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Match actual observations to target times
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  candidates <- target_times %>%

    inner_join(

      data,

      by =
        grouping_vars,

      relationship =
        "many-to-many"

    ) %>%

    mutate(

      time_difference_min =

        abs(

          as.numeric(

            difftime(

              .datetime,

              target_datetime,

              units =
                "mins"

            )

          )

        )

    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Restrict to observations close enough to target
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  candidates <- candidates %>%

    filter(

      time_difference_min <=
        max_difference_min

    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Select nearest actual fix for each target
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  target_group_vars <- c(
    grouping_vars,
    "target_hour"
  )


  regularized <- candidates %>%

    group_by(

      across(
        all_of(
          target_group_vars
        )
      )

    ) %>%

    slice_min(

      order_by =
        time_difference_min,

      n =
        1,

      with_ties =
        FALSE

    ) %>%

    ungroup()


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Prevent one actual fix from filling >1 target
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  regularized <- regularized %>%

    arrange(

      .data[[ID_COL]],

      .datetime,

      time_difference_min

    ) %>%

    distinct(

      .data[[ID_COL]],

      .datetime,

      .keep_all =
        TRUE

    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Sort
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  regularized <- regularized %>%

    arrange(

      .data[[ID_COL]],

      .datetime

    )


  return(
    regularized
  )
}

# 13. REGULARIZE WTD
# ============================================================

summarize_daily_fixes <- function(data) {

  data %>%

    count(

      .data[[ID_COL]],

      .date,

      name =
        "n_fixes"

    ) %>%

    count(

      n_fixes,

      name =
        "n_animal_days"

    ) %>%

    mutate(

      percent =

        round(

          100 *
            n_animal_days /
            sum(
              n_animal_days
            ),

          2

        )

    ) %>%

    arrange(
      n_fixes
    )
}

# ============================================================
# 16. KEEP DAYS WITH AT LEAST 2 TARGET FIXES
# ============================================================

keep_minimum_daily_fixes <- function(
    data,
    minimum_fixes =
      MIN_FIXES_PER_DAY
) {

  data %>%

    group_by(

      .data[[ID_COL]],

      .date

    ) %>%

    filter(

      n() >=
        minimum_fixes

    ) %>%

    ungroup()
}

# ============================================================
# 18. ADD TRAJECTORY SEGMENTS
#
# New segment begins when:
#
#   - first observation for animal
#   - time gap > 16 hours
#
# Movement metrics must later be grouped by:
#
#   id + segment_id
#
# ============================================================

add_segments <- function(data) {

  data %>%

    arrange(

      .data[[ID_COL]],

      .datetime

    ) %>%

    group_by(
      .data[[ID_COL]]
    ) %>%

    mutate(

      gap_hours =

        as.numeric(

          difftime(

            .datetime,

            lag(
              .datetime
            ),

            units =
              "hours"

          )

        ),


      new_segment =

        if_else(

          is.na(
            gap_hours
          ) |

            gap_hours >
              MAX_CONTINUOUS_GAP_HOURS,

          1L,

          0L

        ),


      segment_id =
        cumsum(
          new_segment
        )

    ) %>%

    ungroup()
}


wtd_train_reg <-
  add_segments(
    wtd_train_reg
  )


wtd_test_reg <-
  add_segments(
    wtd_test_reg
  )


mule_train_reg <-
  add_segments(
    mule_train_reg
  )


mule_test_reg <-
  add_segments(
    mule_test_reg
  )

# ============================================================
# 23. INTERVAL SUMMARY
# ============================================================

summarize_intervals <- function(
    data,
    species_name,
    cwd_status,
    dataset_type
) {

  valid_gaps <-
    data$gap_hours[
      !is.na(
        data$gap_hours
      )
    ]


  tibble(

    species =
      species_name,

    cwd_group =
      cwd_status,

    dataset =
      dataset_type,

    median_hours =
      median(
        valid_gaps,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    mean_hours =
      mean(
        valid_gaps,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    sd_hours =
      sd(
        valid_gaps,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )

  )
}


interval_summary <- bind_rows(

  summarize_intervals(
    wtd_train_reg,
    "White-tailed deer",
    "CWD-",
    "training"
  ),

  summarize_intervals(
    wtd_test_reg,
    "White-tailed deer",
    "CWD+",
    "testing"
  ),

  summarize_intervals(
    mule_train_reg,
    "Mule deer",
    "CWD-",
    "training"
  ),

  summarize_intervals(
    mule_test_reg,
    "Mule deer",
    "CWD+",
    "testing"
  )

)


cat(
  "\n\n====================================\n",
  "INTERVAL SUMMARY\n",
  "====================================\n"
)


print(
  interval_summary
)


# ============================================================
# 24. LARGE GAP / SEGMENT SUMMARY
# ============================================================

summarize_segments <- function(
    data,
    species_name,
    cwd_status,
    dataset_type
) {

  tibble(

    species =
      species_name,

    cwd_group =
      cwd_status,

    dataset =
      dataset_type,

    n_locations =
      nrow(
        data
      ),

    n_segments =
      n_distinct(
        interaction(
          data[[ID_COL]],
          data$segment_id
        )
      ),

    gaps_over_16h =
      sum(
        data$gap_hours >
          MAX_CONTINUOUS_GAP_HOURS,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    percent_gaps_over_16h =

      round(

        100 *
          mean(
            data$gap_hours >
              MAX_CONTINUOUS_GAP_HOURS,
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),

        2

      )

  )
}


segment_summary <- bind_rows(

  summarize_segments(
    wtd_train_reg,
    "White-tailed deer",
```

### AKDE again
```{r}
# ============================================================
# CROSS-SPECIES AKDE RECALCULATION
# WTD + MULE DEER
#
# Uses FINAL REGULARIZED GPS DATA
#
# Classification rule:
#
#   RESIDENT:
#     ID has only Phase_1
#
#   MULTI-PHASE / MIGRATORY:
#     ID has Phase_1 plus one or more additional phases
#
# AKDE policy retained from previous analysis:
#
#   - sliding 7-day windows
#   - minimum 20 fixes per ID / ID-phase
#   - minimum 20 fixes per 7-day window
#   - variogram(..., CI = "Gauss")
#   - variogram.fit(..., name = "GuessBM")
#   - ctmm.select(..., IC = "BIC")
#   - akde(..., weights = TRUE)
#   - extract CI low / est / high exactly as before
#
# IMPORTANT:
#   No area-unit conversion is introduced here.
#   low / est / high are extracted the same way as in the
#   previous AKDE code.
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# 1. PACKAGES
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(furrr)
library(future)
library(ctmm)
library(lubridate)


# ============================================================
# 2. PATHS
# ============================================================

BASE_DIR <-
  "<LOCAL_PATH>"


REG_DIR <-
  file.path(
    BASE_DIR,
    "regularized_cross_species"
  )


AKDE_OUT_DIR <-
  file.path(
    BASE_DIR,
    "regularized_cross_species",
    "AKDE_recalculated"
  )


dir.create(
  AKDE_OUT_DIR,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


# ============================================================
# 3. INPUT FILES
# ============================================================

WTD_TRAIN_FILE <- file.path(
  REG_DIR,
  "WTD_CWD_negative_regularized_3target_min2_segmented.csv"
)

WTD_TEST_FILE <- file.path(
  REG_DIR,
  "WTD_CWD_positive_regularized_3target_min2_segmented.csv"
)

MULE_TRAIN_FILE <- file.path(
  REG_DIR,
  "MuleDeer_CWD_negative_regularized_3target_min2_segmented.csv"
)

MULE_TEST_FILE <- file.path(
  REG_DIR,
  "MuleDeer_CWD_positive_regularized_3target_min2_segmented.csv"
)


# ============================================================
# 4. AKDE SETTINGS
# ============================================================

WINDOW_DAYS <- 7

MIN_TOTAL_FIXES <- 20

MIN_WINDOW_FIXES <- 20


# Keep parallelism moderate because ctmm models can use
# substantial RAM.

N_WORKERS <- max(
  1,
  min(
    4,
    parallel::detectCores() - 1
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 5. LOAD FINAL REGULARIZED DATA
# ============================================================

wtd_train <- read_csv(
  WTD_TRAIN_FILE,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

wtd_test <- read_csv(
  WTD_TEST_FILE,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

mule_train <- read_csv(
  MULE_TRAIN_FILE,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

mule_test <- read_csv(
  MULE_TEST_FILE,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


# ============================================================
# 6. ROBUST DATETIME PARSER
#
# Avoids parse_date_time() / regexpr issue encountered earlier.
# ============================================================

parse_gps_datetime <- function(x) {

  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  x <- gsub(
    "T",
    " ",
    x,
    fixed = TRUE
  )

  x <- gsub(
    "Z$",
    "",
    x
  )

  x <- sub(
    "\\.[0-9]+$",
    "",
    x
  )


  out <- as.POSIXct(
    rep(
      NA_character_,
      length(x)
    ),
    tz = "UTC"
  )


  formats <- c(
    "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
    "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M",
    "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S",
    "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M",
    "%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S",
    "%Y/%m/%d %H:%M"
  )


  for (fmt in formats) {

    bad <- is.na(out) & !is.na(x)

    if (!any(bad)) {
      break
    }

    out[bad] <- suppressWarnings(
      as.POSIXct(
        x[bad],
        format = fmt,
        tz = "UTC"
      )
    )
  }


  out
}


# ============================================================
# 7. STANDARDIZE DATETIME
# ============================================================

standardize_datetime <- function(data) {

  if (".datetime" %in% names(data)) {

    data$.datetime <-
      parse_gps_datetime(
        data$.datetime
      )

  } else if ("date_time" %in% names(data)) {

    data$.datetime <-
      parse_gps_datetime(
        data$date_time
      )

  } else {

    stop(
      "Neither .datetime nor date_time was found."
    )
  }


  data %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.datetime)
    )
}


wtd_train <- standardize_datetime(
  wtd_train
)

wtd_test <- standardize_datetime(
  wtd_test
)

mule_train <- standardize_datetime(
  mule_train
)

mule_test <- standardize_datetime(
  mule_test
)


# ============================================================
# 8. STANDARDIZE PHASE LABELS
# ============================================================
#
# We use "phases" because that was the phase field used
# in the previous AKDE workflow.
#
# Examples:
#
#   Phase 1
#   Phase_1
#   phase 1
#
# all become:
#
#   Phase_1
# ============================================================

clean_phase <- function(x) {

  x <- as.character(x)

  x <- str_trim(x)

  x <- str_squish(x)

  x <- str_replace_all(
    x,
    "_",
    " "
  )

  x_lower <- str_to_lower(x)


  # Explicit remove labels stay NA
  x_lower[
    x_lower %in%
      c(
        "",
        "na",
        "remove"
      )
  ] <- NA_character_


  phase_num <- str_extract(
    x_lower,
    "\\d+"
  )


  result <- ifelse(

    !is.na(
      phase_num
    ),

    paste0(
      "Phase_",
      phase_num
    ),

    ifelse(
      is.na(x_lower),
      NA_character_,
      str_replace_all(
        str_to_title(x),
        "\\s+",
        "_"
      )
    )
  )


  result
}


# ============================================================
# 9. PREPARE DATA FOR AKDE
# ============================================================

prepare_akde_data <- function(
    data,
    species_name,
    cwd_status,
    dataset_type
) {

  required_cols <- c(
    "id",
    "longitude",
    "latitude",
    "phases",
    ".datetime"
  )


  missing_cols <- setdiff(
    required_cols,
    names(data)
  )


  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {

    stop(
      paste0(
        species_name,
        " ",
        cwd_status,
        " missing columns: ",
        paste(
          missing_cols,
          collapse = ", "
        )
      )
    )
  }


  data %>%

    mutate(

      id =
        as.character(
          id
        ),

      longitude =
        as.numeric(
          longitude
        ),

      latitude =
        as.numeric(
          latitude
        ),

      phase_label =
        clean_phase(
          phases
        ),

      species =
        species_name,

      cwd_group =
        cwd_status,

      dataset =
        dataset_type

    ) %>%

    filter(

      is.finite(
        longitude
      ),

      is.finite(
        latitude
      ),

      !is.na(
        .datetime
      ),

      !is.na(
        phase_label
      )

    )
}


wtd_train_akde <- prepare_akde_data(
  wtd_train,
  "White-tailed deer",
  "CWD-",
  "training"
)

wtd_test_akde <- prepare_akde_data(
  wtd_test,
  "White-tailed deer",
  "CWD+",
  "testing"
)

mule_train_akde <- prepare_akde_data(
  mule_train,
  "Mule deer",
  "CWD-",
  "training"
)

mule_test_akde <- prepare_akde_data(
  mule_test,
  "Mule deer",
  "CWD+",
  "testing"
)


# ============================================================
# 10. CLASSIFY EACH ID AS RESIDENT OR MULTI-PHASE
#
# FINAL RULE:
#
# Resident =
#   exactly one usable phase AND that phase == Phase_1
#
# Multi-phase =
#   more than one phase
#
# Anything else is flagged for inspection.
# ============================================================

classify_phase_structure <- function(data) {

  data %>%

    distinct(
      id,
      phase_label
    ) %>%

    group_by(
      id
    ) %>%

    summarise(

      n_phases =
        n_distinct(
          phase_label
        ),

      phase_list =
        paste(
          sort(
            unique(
              phase_label
            )
          ),
          collapse = ";"
        ),

      akde_class = case_when(

        n_phases == 1 &
          phase_list == "Phase_1" ~
          "resident",

        n_phases > 1 ~
          "multi_phase",

        TRUE ~
          "check"

      ),

      .groups =
        "drop"

    )
}


# ============================================================
# 11. PHASE CLASSIFICATION FOR ALL FOUR DATASETS
# ============================================================

wtd_train_class <-
  classify_phase_structure(
    wtd_train_akde
  )

wtd_test_class <-
  classify_phase_structure(
    wtd_test_akde
  )

mule_train_class <-
  classify_phase_structure(
    mule_train_akde
  )

mule_test_class <-
  classify_phase_structure(
    mule_test_akde
  )


phase_classification <- bind_rows(

    by = "id"
  )


wtd_test_akde <- wtd_test_akde %>%

# ============================================================
# 14. BUILD RESIDENT / MULTI-PHASE GROUP IDENTIFIERS
# ============================================================

add_akde_group <- function(data) {

  data %>%

    mutate(

      akde_group = case_when(

        akde_class ==
          "resident" ~
          id,

        akde_class ==
          "multi_phase" ~
          paste(
            id,
            phase_label,
            sep = "_"
          ),

        TRUE ~
          NA_character_

      )

    ) %>%

    filter(
      !is.na(
        akde_group
      )
    )
}


wtd_train_akde <-

wtd_test_akde <-

  add_akde_group(

  )

mule_test_akde <-
  add_akde_group(
    mule_test_akde

# ============================================================
# 15. BUILD CTMM TELEMETRY INPUT
# ============================================================

make_telemetry_input <- function(data) {

  data %>%

    transmute(

      individual.local.identifier =
        akde_group,

      location.long =
        longitude,

      location.lat =
        latitude,

      timestamp =
        .datetime

    ) %>%

    arrange(
      individual.local.identifier,
      timestamp
    ) %>%

    distinct(

      individual.local.identifier,

      timestamp,

      .keep_all =
        TRUE

    )
}


# ============================================================
# 16. GENERIC SLIDING-WINDOW AKDE FUNCTION
# ============================================================

run_akde_dataset <- function(
    data,
    dataset_name
) {

  cat(
    "\n\n====================================\n",
    "AKDE DATASET: ",
    dataset_name,
    "\n",
    "====================================\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Telemetry dataframe
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  tel_input <-
    make_telemetry_input(
      data
    )


  cat(
    "Telemetry rows: ",
    nrow(tel_input),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  cat(
    "AKDE groups: ",
    n_distinct(
      tel_input$individual.local.identifier
    ),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Convert to ctmm telemetry
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  tel_list <- as.telemetry(

    tel_input,

    timeformat =
      "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",

    timezone =
      "UTC"

  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Metadata lookup
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  metadata <- data %>%

    distinct(

      akde_group,

      id,

      phase_label,

      akde_class,

      species,

      cwd_group,

      dataset

    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Per-group processor
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  process_one_group <- function(group_name) {

    tel <- tel_list[[group_name]]


    day_sec <-
      24 * 3600


    window_sec <-
      WINDOW_DAYS *
      day_sec


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Safety check
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (is.null(tel)) {

      return(

        list(

          area =
            tibble(),

          uds =
            list(),

          status =
            tibble(

              akde_group =
                group_name,

              status =
                "missing telemetry",

              n_fixes =
                NA_integer_,

              candidate_windows =
                0L,

              successful_windows =
                0L

            )

        )

      )
    }


    n_fixes <-
      length(
        tel$t
      )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Minimum total observations
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
      n_fixes <
        MIN_TOTAL_FIXES
    ) {

      return(

        list(

          area =
            tibble(),

          uds =
            list(),

          status =
            tibble(

              akde_group =
                group_name,

              status =
                "skipped fewer than 20 total fixes",

              n_fixes =
                n_fixes,

              candidate_windows =
                0L,

              successful_windows =
                0L

            )

        )

      )
    }


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Candidate sliding-window starts
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    starts <-
      tel$t[
        tel$t <=
          max(tel$t) -
          window_sec
      ]


    if (
      length(starts) ==
        0
    ) {

      return(

        list(

          area =
            tibble(),

          uds =
            list(),

          status =
            tibble(

              akde_group =
                group_name,

              status =
                "skipped no full 7-day windows",

              n_fixes =
                n_fixes,

              candidate_windows =
                0L,

              successful_windows =
                0L

            )

        )

      )
    }


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Output containers
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    area_rows <-
      tibble(

        window_start =
          as.POSIXct(
            character(),
            tz = "UTC"
          ),

        n_window_fixes =
          integer(),

        low =
          numeric(),

        est =
          numeric(),

        high =
          numeric()

      )


    ud_list <-
      list()


    n_eligible_windows <-
      0L


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Sliding windows
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    for (
      t0 in starts
    ) {

      win <-
        tel[

          tel$t >= t0 &

            tel$t <=
              (
                t0 +
                  window_sec
              ),

        ]


      n_window <-
        length(
          win$t
        )


      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # SAME minimum-window requirement as prior AKDE
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      if (
        n_window <
          MIN_WINDOW_FIXES
      ) {

        next
      }


      n_eligible_windows <-
        n_eligible_windows +
        1L


      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # SAME AKDE MODELING PROCEDURE
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      UD <- tryCatch(
        {

          v0 <-
            variogram(
              win,
              CI = "Gauss"
            )


          v2 <-
            variogram.fit(
              v0,
              name = "GuessBM",
              interactive = FALSE
            )


          m0 <-
            ctmm.select(
              win,
              v2,
              IC = "BIC"
            )


          akde(
            win,
            m0,
            weights = TRUE
          )

        },

        error = function(e) {

          message(
            "AKDE failed for ",
            group_name,
            " at ",
            as.POSIXct(
              t0,
              origin = "1970-01-01",
              tz = "UTC"
            ),
            ": ",
            e$message
          )


          NULL
        }
      )


      if (
        is.null(UD)
      ) {

        next
      }


      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # SAME CI EXTRACTION AS OLD CODE
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      ci <- tryCatch(
        {

          summary(
            UD
          )$CI

        },

        error = function(e) {

          NULL

        }
      )


      if (
        is.null(ci)
      ) {

        next
      }


      ci_tbl <- as_tibble(
        ci,
        rownames = "unit"
      )


      area_row <- ci_tbl %>%

        filter(
          str_starts(
            unit,
            "area"
          )
        ) %>%

        select(
          low,
          est,
          high
        )


      if (
        nrow(area_row) ==
          0
      ) {

        next
      }


      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # Keep successful UD
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      ud_list[[length(ud_list) + 1]] <- UD


      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # Area row
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      area_rows <- bind_rows(

        area_rows,

        tibble(

          window_start =
            as.POSIXct(
              t0,
              origin = "1970-01-01",
              tz = "UTC"
            ),

          n_window_fixes =
            n_window,

          low =
            area_row$low,

          est =
            area_row$est,

          high =
            area_row$high

        )

      )

    }


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Add group identifier
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    area_rows <- area_rows %>%

      mutate(
        akde_group =
          group_name
      ) %>%

      select(

        akde_group,

        window_start,

        n_window_fixes,

        low,

        est,

        high

      )


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Status
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    status_text <- case_when(

      nrow(area_rows) > 0 ~
        "processed",

      n_eligible_windows == 0 ~
        "no windows with >=20 fixes",

      TRUE ~
        "eligible windows but no successful AKDE"

    )


    status <- tibble(

      akde_group =
        group_name,

      status =
        status_text,

      n_fixes =
        n_fixes,

      candidate_windows =
        length(
          starts
        ),

      eligible_20fix_windows =
        n_eligible_windows,

      successful_windows =
        nrow(
          area_rows
        )

    )


    list(

      area =
        area_rows,

      uds =
        ud_list,

      status =
        status

    )
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Parallel processing
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  results <- future_map(

    names(
      tel_list
    ),

    process_one_group,

    .progress =
      TRUE,

    .options =
      furrr_options(
        seed = TRUE
      )

  )


  names(results) <-
    names(
      tel_list
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Extract outputs
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  area_df <-
    map_dfr(
      results,
      "area"
    )


  status_df <-
    map_dfr(
      results,
      "status"
    )


  ud_lists <-
    map(
      results,
      "uds"
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Add ID / phase / resident classification
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  area_df <- area_df %>%

    left_join(
      metadata,
      by = "akde_group"
    ) %>%

    arrange(
      id,
      phase_label,
      window_start
    )


  status_df <- status_df %>%

    left_join(
      metadata,
      by = "akde_group"
    ) %>%

    arrange(
      id,
      phase_label
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Report
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  cat(
    "\nStatus count<LOCAL_PATH>"
  )


  print(

    status_df %>%

      count(
        status,
        sort = TRUE
      ),

    n = Inf
  )


  cat(
    "\nAKDE area rows: ",
    nrow(area_df),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Return everything
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  list(

    area =
      area_df,

    status =
      status_df,

    uds =
      ud_lists,

    telemetry =
      tel_input,

    metadata =
      metadata

  )
}


# ============================================================
# 17. START PARALLEL PLAN
# ============================================================

plan(

options(

# 27. SAVE UD LISTS
# ============================================================

save_ud_lists <- function(
    ud_lists,
    dataset_prefix
) {

  out_dir <- file.path(

    AKDE_OUT_DIR,

    paste0(
      dataset_prefix,
      "_UD_lists"
    )

  )


  dir.create(

    out_dir,

    recursive = TRUE,

    showWarnings = FALSE

  )


  for (
    nm in names(
      ud_lists
    )
  ) {

    this_ud <- ud_lists[[nm]]


    if (
      length(
        this_ud
      ) ==
        0
    ) {

      next
    }


    safe_nm <-
      nm %>%

      str_replace_all(
        "[^A-Za-z0-9_]+",
        "_"
      )


    saveRDS(

      this_ud,

      file.path(

        out_dir,

        paste0(
          safe_nm,
          "_UD_list.rds"
        )

      ),

      compress =
        "gzip"

    )
  }
}

  "WTD_CWD_negative"

  "WTD_CWD_positive"
```

### AKDE Merge
```{r}
# ============================================================
# MERGE RECALCULATED AKDE BACK ONTO REGULARIZED GPS DATA
# 
# IMPORTANT:
# This script DOES NOT calculate movement metrics
#
# It only does the following:
#
#   1. Uses the four regularized GPS datasets
#   2. Uses the completed AKDE result
#   3. Reconstructs resident vs multi-phase AKDE groups
#   4. Matches each AKDE estimate to it exact window_start
#   5. Saves AKDE-enriched GPS datasets
#
# Movement metrics will be recalcuated AFTER this step
#
# ============================================================

# ============================================================
# 1. PACKAGES
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(tibble)

# ============================================================
# 2. REQUIRED OBJECTS
# ============================================================
#
# Regularized GPS:
#
#   wtd_train_reg
#   wtd_test_reg
#   mule_train_reg
#   mule_test_reg
#
# AKDE results rom the script currently running at home:
#
#   wtd_train_result
#   wtd_test_result
#   mule_train_result
#   mule_test_result
#
# ALSO:
#
#   phase_classification
# ============================================================

requierd_objects <- c(
  "wtd_train_reg",
  "wtd_test_reg",
  "mule_train_reg",
  "mule_test_reg",
  "wtd_train_result",
  "wtd_test_result",
  "mule_train_result",
  "mule_test_result",
  "phase_classification"
)

missing_objects <- required_objects[
  !vapply(
    required_objects,
    exists,
    logical(1),
    inherits = TRUE
  )
]

if (length(missing_objects) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "\nMissing required object<LOCAL_PATH>",
      paste(
        missing_objects,
        collapse = "\n"
      ),
      "\n\nFinish the AKDE pipeline first."
    )
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 3. OUTPUT DIRECTORY
# ============================================================

BASE_DIR <-
  "UDPATE_WITH_DESKTOP_AT_HOME"


AKDE_MERGED_DIR <- file.path(
  BASE_DIR,
  "regularized_cross_species",
  "AKDE_merged"
)

dir.create(
  AKDE_MERGED_DIR,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# 4. CLEAN PHASE LABELS
#
# Must use exactly the same convention as the AKDE pipeline
#
# Example:
#   Phase 1
#   Phase_1
#   phase 1
#
# all become:
#
#   Phase_1
# ============================================================

clean_phase <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- str_trim(x)
  x <- str_squish(x)
  x <- str_replace_all(
    x,
    "-",
    " "
  )
  
  x_lower <- str_to_lower(x)
  x_lower[
    x_lower %in%
      c(
        "",
        "na",
        "remove"
      )
  ] <- NA_character_
  
  phase_num <- str_extract(
    x_lower,
    "\\d+"
  )
  
  result <- ifelse(
    !is.na(
      phase_num
    ),
    paste0(
      "Phase_",
      phase_num
    ),
    ifelse(
      is.na(
        x_lower
      ),
      str_replace_all(
        str_to_title(x),
        "\\s+",
        "-"
      )
    )
  )
  result
}

# ============================================================
# 5. COMBINE THE FOUR AKDE AREA TABLES
# ============================================================

akde_area_all <- bind_rows(
  wtd_train_result$area,
  wtd_test_result$area,
  mule_train_result$area,
  mule_test_result$area
)

cat(
  "\n\n============================================================\n",
  "COMBINED AKDE AREA\n",
  "============================================================\n"
)

cat(
  "Total successful AKDE windows: ",
  nrow(akde_area_all),
  "\n",
  sep =""
)

# ============================================================
# 6. STANDARDIZE AKDE OUTPUT COLUMNS
#
# We rename low / est / high now so they cannot be confused
# with any older AKDE columns already present in the datasets
# ============================================================

akde_merge_table <- akde_area_all %>%
  mutate(
    id =
      as.character(
        id
      ),
    akde_window_start =
      as.POSIXct(
        window_start,
        tz = "UTC"
      ),
    akde_window_end =
      adke_window_start +
      days(7)
  ) %>%
  rename(
    akde_low = 
      low,
    akde_est = 
      est,
    akde_high =
      high
  ) %>%
  select(
    species,
    cwd_group,
    dataset,
    id,
    phase_label,
    akde_class,
    akde_group,
    akde_window_start,
    akde_window_end,
    n_window_fixes,
    akde_low,
    akde_est,
    akde_high
  )

# ============================================================
# 7. CHECK FOR DUPLICATES AKDE KEYS
# 
# There should be ONE AKDE estimate per:
#     akde_group + window_start
#
# ============================================================

duplicate_akde_windows <- akde_merge_table %>%
  count(
    species,
    cwd_group,
    dataset,
    akde_group,
    akde_window_start,
    name =
      "n"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    n > 1
  )
cat(
  "\n\n============================================================\n",
  "DUPLICATE AKDE WINDOW CHECH\n",
  "============================================================"
)

if (
  nrow(
    duplicate_akde_windows
  ) ==
  0
) {
  cat(
    "PASS: No duplicate AKDE windows.\n"
  )
} else {
  cat(
    "WARNING: Duplicate AKDE windows found.\n"
  )
  
  print(
    duplicate_akde_windows,
    n = Inf
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 8. PREPARE PHASE CLASSIFICATION LOOKUP
#
# Resident:
#
#   only Phase_1
#
# Multi-phase:
#   more than one phase
#
# ============================================================

phase_lookup <- phase_classification %>%
  select(
    species,
    cwd_group,
    dataset,
    id,
    n_phases,
    phase_list,
    akde_class
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    id =
      as.character(
        id
      )
  ) %>%
  distinct()

# ============================================================
# 9. PREPARE REGULARIZED DATASET 
# ============================================================

prepare_regularized_for_akde <- function(
    data,
    dataset_name
) {
  cat(
    "\n\n============================================================\n",
    "PREPARING: ",
    dataset_name,
    "\n",
    "===========================================================\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      id =
        as.character(
          id
        ),
      .datetime = 
        as.POSIXct(
          .datetime,
          tz = "UTC"
        )
    )
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Ensure phases exists
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (
    !"phases" %in%
      names(
        data
      )
  ) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        dataset_name,
        " does not contain 'phases' column."
      )
    )
  }
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Standardize phase
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      phase_label_current =
        clean_phase(
          phases
        )
    )
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Remove old classification columns if present
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  
  data <- data %>%
    select(
      -any_of(
        c(
          "n_phases",
          "phase_list",
          "akde_class",
          "akde_group"
        )
      )
    )
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Add phase classification
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  
  data <- data %>%
    left_join(
      phase_lookup,
      by = c(
        "species",
        "cwd_group",
        "dataset",
        "id"
      )
    )
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Construct same group identifier used by AKDE
  # 
  # Resident:
  #   ID
  # Multi-phase:
  #   ID_Phase
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      akde_group = case_when(
        akde_class ==
          "resident" ~
          id,
        akde_class ==
          "multi_phase" &
          !is.na(
            phase_label_current
          ) ~ 
          paste(
            id,
            phase_label_current
          ) ~ 
          paste(
            id,
            phase_label_current,
            sep = "_"
          ),
        TRUE ~
          NA_character_
      )
    )
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # Diagnostics
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  cat(
    "Rows: ",
    nrow(data),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  
  cat(
    "Animals: ",
    n_distinct(
      data$id
    ),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  
  cat(
    "Rows with AKDE group: ",
    sum(
      !is.na(
        data$akde_group
      )
    ),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  
  cat(
    "Rows missing AKDE group: ",
    sum(
      is.na(
        data$akde_group
      )
    ),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  data
}

# ============================================================
# 10. PREPARE ALL FOUR DATASETS
# ============================================================

wtd_train_premerge <- prepare_regularized_for_akde(
  wtd_train_reg,
  "WTD CWD- TRAINING"
)

wtd_test_premerge <- prepare_regularized_for_akde(
  wtd_test_reg,
  "WTD CWD+ Testing"
)

mule_train_premerge <- prepare_regularized_for_akde(
  mule_train_reg,
  "MULE CWD- TRAINING"
)

mule_test_premerge <- prepare_regularized_for_akde(
  mule_test_reg,
  "MULE CWD+ TESTING"
)

# ============================================================
# 11. REMOVE OLD AKDE COLUMNS
#
# Original source CSVs already contained previous AKDE
# variables. Don't want those accidentally entering the
# new cross-species analysis
#
# Only remove old AKDE feature names if present
# ============================================================

remove_old_akde <- function(data) {
  old_akde_columns <- c(
    "akde_low",
    "akde_est",
    "akde_high",
    "AKDE_low",
    "AKDE_est",
    "AKDE_high",
    "akde_lci",
    "akde_uci",
    "AKDE_LCI",
    "AKDE_UCI",
    "space_use-Low",
    "space_use_est",
    "space_use_high",
    "akde_window_start",
    "akde_window_end",
    "n_window_fixes"
  )
  data %>%
    select(
      -any_of(
        old_akde_columns
      )
    )
}

wtd_train_premerge <-
  remove_old_akde(
    wtd_train_premerge
  )

wtd_test_premerge <-
  remove_old_akde(
    wtd_test_premerge
  )
mule_train_premerge <- 
  remove_old_akde(
    mule_train_premerge
  )
mule_test_premerge <-
  remove_old_akde(
    mule_test_premerge
  )

# ============================================================
# 12. AKDE MERGE FUNCTION
#
# IMPORTANT:
#
# The AKDE window starts on an actual telemetry observation.
#
# Therefore we match:
#
#   GPS .datetime
#
# exacatly to:
#
#   AKDE window_start
#
# within the same AKDE group.
#
# We DO NOT carry AKDE values forward
# We DO NOT interpolate AKDE
# We DO NOT average overlapping AKDE widows
# ============================================================

merge_akde_exact <- function(
    gps_data,
    akde_data,
    dataset_name
) {
  cat(
    "\n\n============================================================\n",
    "MERGING AKDE: ",
    dataset_name,
    "\n",
    "============================================================\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Determine dataset identify
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  species_value <- 
    unique(
      gps_data$species
    )
  cwd_value <-
    unique(
      gps_data$cwd_group
    )
  data_value <-
    unique(
      gps_data$dataset
    )
  if(
    length(
      species_value
    ) !=
      1 ||
    length(
      cwd_value
    ) !=
      1 ||
    length(
      cwd_value
    ) !=
      1 ||
    length(
      dataset_value
    ) !=
      1
  ) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        dataset_name,
        ": expected one species/CWD/dataset combination."
      )
    )
  }
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Restrict AKDE to this dataset
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  this_akde <- akde_data %>%
    filter(
      species ==
        species_value,
      cwd_group ==
        cwd_value,
      dataset ==
        dataset_value
    ) %>%
    select(
      akde_group,
      akde_window_start,
      akde_window_end,
      n_window_fixes,
      akde_low,
      akde_est,
      akde_high
    )
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  # Exact join
  # --------------------------------------------------------
  result <- gps_data %>%
    left_join(
      this_akde,
      by = join_by(
        akde_group,
        .datetime ==
          akde_window_start
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      id,
      .datetime
    )
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Diagnostics
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  matched_rows <-
    sum(
      !is.na(
        result$akde_est
      )
    )
  cat(
    "GPS rows: ",
    nrow(result),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  cat(
    "Rows with new AKDE: ",
    matched_rows,
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  cat(
    "Percent with AKDE: ",
    round(
      100 *
        matched_rows /
        nrow(result),
      2
    ),
    "%\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  cat(
    "Animal with >=1 new AKDE: ",
    result %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(
          akde_est
        )
      ) %>%
      summarise(
        n =
          n_distinct(
            id
          )
      ) %>%
      pull(
        n
      ),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  result
}

# ============================================================
# 13. MERGE AKDE INTO ALL FOUR REGULARIZED DATASET
# ============================================================

wtd_train_akde_merged <- merge_akde_exact(
  wtd_train_premerge,
  akde_merge_table,
  "WTD CWD- TRAINING"
)

wtd_test_akde_merged <- merge_akde_exact(
  wtd_test_premerge,
  akde_merge_table,
  "WTD CWD+ TESTING"
)

mule_train_akde_merged <- merge_akde_exact(
  mule_train_premerge,
  akde_merge_table,
  "MULE CWD- TRAINING"
)

mule_test_akde_merged <- merge_akde_exact(
  mule_test_premerge,
  akde_merge_table,
  "MULE CWD+ TESTING"
)

# ============================================================
# 14. DATASET-LEVEL MATCH SUMMARY
# ============================================================

summarize_akde_merge <- function(
    data,
    dataset_name
) {
  animal_total <-
    n_distinct(
      data$id
    )
  animals_with_akde <-
    data %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(
        akde_est
      )
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      n =
        n_distinct(
          id
        )
    ) %>%
    pull(
      n
    )
  tibble(
    dataset = 
      dataset_name,
    n_animals =
      animals_total,
    animals_with_akde =
      animals_with_akde,
    animals_without_akde =
      animals_total -
      animals_with_akde,
    n_rows =
      nrow(
        data
      ),
    rows_with_akde =
      sum(
        !is.na(
          data$akde_est
        )
      ),
    percent_rows_wih_akde =
      round(
        100 *
          mean(
            !is.na(
              data$akde_est
            )
          ),
        2
      )
  )
}

akde_merge_summary <- bind_rows(
  summarize_akde_merge(
    wtd_train_akde_merged,
    "WTD CWD-"
  ),
  summarize_akde_merge(
    wtd_test_akde_merged,
    "WTD CWD+"
  ),
  summarize_akde_merge(
    mule_train_akde_merged,
    "Mule CWD-"
  ),
  summarize_akde_merge(
    mule_test_akde_merged,
    "Mule CWD+"
  )
)

cat(
  "\n\n============================================================\n",
  "AKDE MERGE SUMMARY\n",
  "============================================================\n"
)

print(
  akde_merge_summary
)


# ============================================================
# 15. FIND ANIMALS WITH NO SUCCESSFUL AKDE
# ============================================================

find_animals_without_akde <- function(
    data,
    dataset_name
) {
  all_ids <- data %>%
    distinct(
      id
    )
  akde_ids <- data %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(
        akde_est
      )
    ) %>%
    distinct(
      id
    )
  anti_join(
    all_ids,
    akde_ids,
    by =
      "id"
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      dataset =
        dataset_name
    ) %>%
    select(
      dataset,
      id
    )
}


animals_without_akde <- bind_rows(
  find_animals_without_akde(
    wtd_train_akde_merged,
    "WTD CWD-"
  ),
  find_animals_without_akde(
    wtd_test_akde_merged,
    "WTD CWD+"
  ),
  find_animals_without_akde(
    mule_train_akde_merged,
    "Mule CWD-"
  ),
  find_animals_without_akde(
    mule_test_akde_merged,
    "Mule CWD+"
  )
)

cat(
  "\n\n============================================================\n",
  "ANIMALS WITHOUR ANY AKDE\n",
  "============================================================\n"
)

print(
  animals_without_akde,
  n = Inf
)

# 16. CHECK AKDE VALUES

akde_value_summary <- bind_rows(
  wtd_train_akde_merged %>%
    mutate(
      data_name =
        "WTD CWD-"
    ),
  wtd_test_akde_merged %>%
    mutate(
      dataset_name =

    ),
  mule_train_akde_merged %>%
    mutate(
      dataset_name =
        "Mule CWD-"
    ),
  mule_test_akde_merged %>%
    mutate(
      dataset_name =
        "Mule CWD+"
    )
) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(
      akde_est
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    dataset_name
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_akde = 
      n(),
    median_low =
      median(
        akde_low,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    median_est =
      median(
        akde_est,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    median_high =
      median(
        akde_high,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    min_est =
      min(
        akde_est,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    max_est =
      max(
        akde_est,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    .groups =
      "drop"
  )

cat(
  "\n\n============================================================\n",
  "AKDE VALUE SUMMARY",
  "============================================================\n"
)

print(
  akde_value_summary
)
```
